履修条件
Students who conduct research using archaeological human skeletal remains, those working in related fields, or those who wish to use 3D scanning or CT imaging in their research are particularly encouraged to enroll.
授業概要
自然人類学に関する諸先行研究や海外の研究動向を学ぶ。各自の研究において３Dデータ（SpiderやKeyence）、CTなどの使用を希望する場合はデータの生成の仕方について実践を行う。その場合は研究対象となる資料・標本を持ってくる必要がある。
Students will study previous research in biological anthropology as well as recent international research trends. If students wish to use 3D data (e.g., Spider or Keyence scanners) or CT imaging in their own research, practical training on how to generate such data will be provided. In that case, students will need to bring the materials or specimens that will serve as their research subjects

全体の教育目標
The aim of this course is to develop an understanding of major previous studies in biological anthropology as well as current international research trends. Students will also learn the fundamentals of digital measurement techniques, such as 3D scanners and CT imaging, used in the morphological study of human skeletal and other biological materials. Furthermore, the course aims to equip students with the basic knowledge and practical skills necessary to apply these methods to their own research topics and to develop the ability to independently advance research in biological anthropology.
個別の教育目標
The course aims not only to review the historiography and research trends in the field, but also to connect this broader understanding organically to each student’s own research. In addition, students will aim to become proficient in operating the equipment used to generate various types of 3D data, ultimately acquiring the ability to use these instruments independently.
